name: Hotel camera
steps: Tap the table lamp to find a hidden camera.
Tap the power outlet to reveal a camera.
Open the window blinds and remove the camera.
Tap the air conditioner to find the hidden camera.
Check the plant pot for a buried camera.
Tap the light switch panel to reveal a camera.
Tap the teddy bear’s eye to find the lens.
Tap the wall painting to uncover a camera behind it.
Tap the mirror to reveal the final hidden camera room.
